title: Grounds, a trumpeter who wrote Sweet and Lovely
summary: He praises writers in the band, one Grounds, a trumpeter who finished a piece, and the strong trumpet section.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, neighboring man, boy, that thing was hell. Boy, all them guys could write. I'm not forget the sweet and lovely. This boy, Grounds, took a long time to finish it, but he finished it, boy. That was a pretty boy, that was a pretty peak boy, that man wrote.
Trumpets. Boy could play up there, too. All the cats could play, all four in front of the players could play up there. Couldn't tell one another boy, I'm glad.
